Long-form vs Shorts

Long-form video (YouTube) keeps 55% of ad revenue and typically pays $1–$17 RPM by niche. Shorts run on a pooled model around $0.02–$0.15 per 1,000 views — 30 to 100 times less. TikTok Creator Rewards and Instagram Reels sit in a similar short-form range. Pick your platform's effective per-thousand rate and the formula works anywhere.

How to find your real RPM

YouTube Studio → Analytics → Revenue shows your actual RPM. TikTok's Creator Rewards dashboard shows its per-1,000-qualified-views rate. Replace the benchmark with your real number for an exact figure.

Frequently asked questions

How many views do I need to make $1,000 a month?

Divide $1,000 by your RPM and multiply by 1,000. At a $5 RPM that's 200,000 monthly views; at a $15 finance-tier RPM, about 67,000.

Does this work for TikTok or Instagram?

Yes — the math is platform-agnostic: views × your per-thousand rate ÷ 1,000. Just enter that platform's effective rate, which is far lower than YouTube long-form.
